messages.author: nitin_fighter1379
messages.content:
<@1425527200941080677> 

Thank you for reaching out and informing us about your situation. We completely understand that managing dual degree commitments along with continuous sessional exams can be demanding, and academics should always take priority.

Given your current schedule, it would be best for you to step back from this cohort for now. However, you are absolutely welcome to join a later cohort once your academic commitments ease. We appreciate your interest and sincerity, and we wish you the very best for your exams.

Looking forward to having you with us in the future!
